algorithm.name: Script-Contrastive Identity Lattice
algorithm.representation: Split official public identity metadata into English-word, traditional/simplified-folded Han unigram/bigram, and exact public-mark carriers. Weight evidence atoms by frozen candidate-pack distinctiveness, fuse agreeing carriers, veto strong cross-carrier disagreement to UNKNOWN, and preserve the appearance decision when no proof exists.

interpretation: SCIL crossed the frozen conditional identity gate and repaired the exact PB3 failure mode. On the fresh test split it proved every source-labeled identity-bearing view with zero wrong proofs, while the flat bilingual whole-alias matcher proved none of those four views. Weighted partial Han evidence also recovered the Xiqu Centre context frame from the OCR corruption 截曲中心 without turning the two text-absent contexts into NONE.
successor: Retain SCIL as a conditional proof-positive named-place authority. The next legal experiment may join only a current SCIL-proved frame to a separately frozen functional portal-set proposal. Text-UNKNOWN frames remain blocked from portal ownership and request APPROACH_TEXT or SWEEP_SIGN; do not tune the consumed PB4 cohort.
claim_boundary: Fresh entity-disjoint public-image confirmation of conditional bilingual signage identity on a deliberately identity-opportunity-stratified cohort. Wrong-request pairs are source-label proxies rather than exhaustive physical absence. The result does not establish natural prevalence, open-world identity, portal ownership, access, active-view causality, tracking, guidance, navigation, arrival, product benefit, user benefit, or safety.
